title: Self-driving software startup Oxa raised a $103M Series D, with $50M coming from the UK government's National Wealth Fund; Nvidia's NVentures also invested (Tom Nugent/Sifted)
summary: Tom Nugent / Sifted: Self-driving software startup Oxa raised a $103M Series D, with $50M coming from the UK government's National Wealth Fund; Nvidia's NVentures also invested — Oxa develops self-driving software for industrial use cases, with customers including BP, DHL and Vantec
